why:
This script uses Series 1 ('The 9:40 PM Call') and the viral 'missed calls are lost revenue' pain point from the strategy to target overloaded clinic owners. The goal is to prompt dental practice managers to call the live demo line and discover the automated 24/7 receptionist.
Some shots come from a viral video in your niche (35.6M views) to boost reach; your product and call to action open and close the video.

problems: Generic stock footage of receptionists and patients
Persistent fine print disclaimer covers the video lower middle area
Weak ending slide showing Tepexa branding instead of Dentovox clear CTA
qa.fix: Replace generic stock clips with actual UI demonstrations of Dentovox booking appointments and end with a clear branded Dentovox call to action.
